pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED PATTERNS — every number re-run against PostgreSQL this cycle (meta_rsi only; entry_rsi_14 never touched). Reproducibility check vs the 12:50 cycle: windows shifted by ~30 min, all conclusions unchanged.

1) EXIT FAMILIES (7d, n=101 closed): profit-monster-trail 35T/31W (88.6%)/+1.75 — THE WINNING SIDE. Never-armed family: atr_sl_hit 36T/1W/-2.46 (largest single drain), hard_max_loss 18T/0W/-2.18, stale_exit 4T/0W/-0.77, trail_arm_timeout 9T/2W/-0.44, hard_sl 5T/0W/-0.42 → 72 exits / 4 wins / -6.39 combined. WHY WE AREN'T ON THE WINNING SIDE: the winning side is every trade where price reached +0.40% and the trail armed. The 72 never got there — we are entering tape where +0.40% is not available, not mismanaging exits.

2) SIGNAL DRAINS (7d, n>=4): pump-chain+ 14T/1W/-1.21 (worst; prior 14d check also negative), bb-bounce-v2-long+ 19T/9W/-0.58 (holds our open trade + steer-001's streak), ai-trader+ 9T/3W/-0.54, doji-bottom-long 8T/3W/-0.52, ai-trader-pending 13T/2W/-0.22, hl_copy_trader 4T/0W/-0.21. The winners in the book come from the trail exit path, not from these signal entries — we keep feeding losers into the same signals while the P&L is made by a different exit family.

3) RSI BAND (7d, meta_rsi, n=115): LONG 45-60 = 49T/17W (35%)/-2.26, avg -0.046 — worst cell, reproduced 2nd consecutive cycle. LONG >=72 = 6T/4W/+0.47. SHORT 60-72 = 5T/4W/+0.65 avg +0.130 (best avg, n=5, not significant alone). SHORT <60 = 19T/5W/-1.20. THE WINNING SIDE: extreme-band entries, not mid-band. WHY WEREN'T WE ON IT: the RSI gates and pick guidance funnel entries into 45-60, exactly where the bleed is — and the precheck's own 'death zone advisory' fired on every candidate this cycle. Brain auditor's call, flagged not changed.

4) LAST 24h LOSERS (6 of 13; book +0.030) — for each, the winning side:
   - #16364 ZRO SHORT -4.88% hard_max_loss, meta_rsi 43.3 (below the 45 short floor): dump already over at entry. Winning side: LONG.
   - #16363 CC SHORT -3.95% stale_exit, meta_rsi 38.1: deep oversold short; regime_5m now reads CC LONG_BIAS conf 84.8. Winning side: LONG, and the tape said so within the hour.
   - #16360 WLFI LONG -4.83% hard_max_loss, meta_rsi 57.1: mid-band long into a coin whose regime reads SHORT_BIAS. Winning side: SHORT.
   - #16359 ME LONG -1.37% trail_arm_timeout, meta_rsi 74.7: above the 72 long ceiling. Winning side: no long at all.
   - #16358 BTC LONG -1.03% and #16353 BTC SHORT -1.53%, both UNIVERSAL_MAX_HOLD after 8h: chop bled out on time, both directions. Winning side: no BTC position.
   4 of 6 losers were entered outside the allowed RSI band or against the coin's own regime — each is a direct violation of an existing gate, not a new pattern needing a new filter.
